'''Lisa Adams''' is an American voice actress who was one of the original voice actresses for the English-language dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is currently affiliated with DDO Artists Agency.

==Biography==
Adams was born in Joplin, Missouri, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during [[S06|season six]], and remained in the cast until its dubbing production was taken over by {{TPCi|Pokémon USA}} and [[TAJ Productions]]. Adams returned to the cast in ''[[M21|The Power of Us]]'', where she voiced [[Townes, Hoyt, and Miles|Townes]].
